wiki.summary: “WNBA” is a song by Drake that centers on a long-distance relationship affected by constant travel and emotional uncertainty. Throughout the track, Drake talks about a partner who frequently travels from place to place, creating emotional distance between the two. Despite this, Drake attempts to keep the relationship together by supporting and reassuring his partner. The song’s title references the professional basketball league, the Women’s National Basketball Association. Read more on Last.fm.
